description: Perform an offline static security review of the committed lockfiles and apply only safe, registry-independent dependency vulnerability fixes, then open a single pull request against main. Because registry.npmjs.org is unreachable (see FEAT-001), `npm audit fix` and registry-backed dependency bumps cannot be executed or verified. The deliverable is therefore: (1) an offline static review of site/package-lock.json identifying known-vulnerable transitive packages, (2) any dependency fix that can be made WITHOUT contacting the registry and that keeps the lockfile internally consistent (only if it can be done safely; otherwise leave unaddressed and document), and (3) a PR that clearly documents before/after audit counts (audit could not run -> documented as blocked) and lists offline-identified vulnerabilities left unaddressed with reasons attributing them to the Repository access only network mode. Changes MUST be limited to dependency vulnerability fixes; NO unrelated refactoring or formatting.
steps: Read site/package-lock.json and site/.snyk. Produce an offline static assessment of known-vulnerable packages/versions in the dependency tree (e.g. inspect pinned transitive versions of commonly-flagged packages). Write the assessment to .agents/tasks/task-npm-security-audit/offline-analysis.md, grouping findings by severity (critical/high/moderate/low) where identifiable, and noting that severities are from static knowledge, not a live `npm audit` run.

Determine whether any identified fix can be applied WITHOUT registry access. A manifest version bump in package.json alone does NOT update the lockfile's resolved/integrity entries, and new integrity hashes cannot be fetched offline, so a bump cannot be installed or verified. If NO fix can be safely applied offline, make NO dependency edits and record this; do not fabricate integrity hashes and do not run `npm audit fix --force`.

If (and only if) a genuinely safe, registry-independent fix exists, apply it to the appropriate manifest/lockfile, keep the change minimal and dependency-only, and verify the edited JSON remains valid (`node -e "require('./site/package-lock.json')"` or `python -m json.tool`).
Verify the diff is dependency-only: run `git diff main` and confirm no source/formatting/refactor changes were introduced. Confirm no node_modules is staged.

Commit the changes (task artifacts + any dependency fix) on branch chore/npm-security-audit-review with a message beginning `chore(security): 依存脆弱性の修正`. Stage specific files by name; do not use `git add -A`.
Push the branch to origin: `git push -u origin chore/npm-security-audit-review` (NO force-push).

Create the PR via REST (gh GraphQL is broken here): `gh api repos/midnight480/tools/pulls -f title='chore(security): 依存脆弱性の修正' -f body="$(cat <bodyfile>)" -f head='chore/npm-security-audit-review' -f base='main'`. The PR body MUST contain: a before/after audit count table for critical/high/moderate/low (with the honest note that `npm audit` could not run because registry.npmjs.org is unreachable under the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY / Repository access only network mode, including the exact 403 Forbidden error), the offline static findings summary, and a list of vulnerabilities left unaddressed each with its reason.
Apply the security label: capture the PR number from the create response, then `gh api repos/midnight480/tools/issues/{pr_number}/labels -f "labels[]=security"`.
Record the PR number, URL, and final status in the feature findings field.
acceptance_criteria: .agents/tasks/task-npm-security-audit/offline-analysis.md exists and lists statically-identified vulnerabilities grouped by severity with the caveat that no live audit was possible.

Any dependency change (if present) is limited to vulnerability fixes with no unrelated refactoring/formatting, and edited JSON files are valid; if no safe offline fix exists, no dependency files are modified and this is documented.
A single pull request against main exists with title exactly `chore(security): 依存脆弱性の修正`.

The PR body includes before/after audit counts (critical/high/moderate/low) with an explicit, honest statement that npm audit was blocked by the network mode (including the 403 Forbidden evidence), plus the list of unaddressed vulnerabilities and reasons.
The `security` label is applied to the PR.
The branch chore/npm-security-audit-review is pushed to origin without force-push.
verification: Run `git log --oneline -3` and confirm the security commit is present on chore/npm-security-audit-review.
Run `git diff --name-only main` and confirm only dependency/task-artifact files changed (no unrelated source edits).
Confirm the PR exists: `gh api repos/midnight480/tools/pulls --jq '.[] | select(.head.ref=="chore/npm-security-audit-review") | {number,title,draft}'`.
Validate any edited JSON file parses successfully.
findings: Offline static security review completed and written to .agents/tasks/task-npm-security-audit/offline-analysis.md. npm audit/fix/registry install remain blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (registry.npmjs.org -> 403 Forbidden via Squid on the advisories/bulk endpoint; root install -> E403 on @bazel/bazelisk tarball; curl -> 000). Static assessment of site/package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3) flagged known-vulnerable transitive devDependency versions grouped by severity: HIGH = trim 0.0.1, lodash 3.10.1 (jscs/jsdoctypeparser/xmlbuilder chains), lodash.template 2.4.1/3.6.2, minimist 0.0.10/0.2.4, uglify-js 2.6.0, underscore 1.6.0; MODERATE = braces 1.8.5/2.3.2, micromatch 2.3.11/3.1.10, qs 2.2.4/2.2.5, debug 0.8.1, postcss 5.2.18/6.0.23/7.0.39, kind-of 3.2.2/4.0.0; LOW = deep-extend 0.4.2. Top-level lodash 4.17.23/minimist 1.2.8/braces 3.0.3/micromatch 4.0.8/postcss 8.5.8 are already patched. NO dependency files were modified: a package.json bump does not update lockfile resolved/integrity entries and fresh integrity hashes cannot be fetched offline, so no fix could be installed/built/tested; per user instruction all findings are carried as 未対応 (unaddressed) with the inability attributed to the network mode. No integrity hashes fabricated; no `npm audit fix --force` run. git diff vs main is task-artifact-only (no source/formatting changes, no node_modules). PR #12 (https://github.com/midnight480/tools/pull/12) opened against main from branch chore/npm-security-audit-review, title exactly 'chore(security): 依存脆弱性の修正', state=open, label 'security' applied. Commit 1d89f42 on chore/npm-security-audit-review. Branch pushed to origin without force-push. PR body contains the honest before/after audit table (all cells '取得不能' with the 403 Forbidden / registry-unreachable note, no fake zeros), the offline static findings summary, and the 未対応 list with per-item reasons attributing the inability to apply/verify to the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Final status: completed.
